{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Apollo|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Apollo''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Impaling}} III and {{MCW|Piercing}} II. It is crafted from four [[Spectral Arrow]]s, three gold ingots and a {{MCW|Disc Fragment|disc fragment}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/piercing_impaling.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Apollo" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Apollo is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Impaling applies to tridents and Piercing to crossbows. Both levels are below the vanilla maximums (Impaling V, Piercing IV).

== Trivia ==
* Apollo is the Greek god of archery and music, reflected in the arrows and the music disc fragment in the recipe. One of the pack's title-screen splashes reads "Ft. Apollo: Our Fave Problematic King!".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Ft. Apollo: Our Fave Problematic King!}}</ref>
